host_profile.original: complete unchanged Axis.__init__/clear, original overlap property, real Ticker/Scale/factory/default setter bodies and named ticker classes
host_profile.sinks: Text/artist presentation, callback registry, explicit context/graph host; view/data supplied independently of the implementation
host_profile.portable: finished direction-aware Axis construction; in-place Axis clear preserving view/inversion/overlap and stable context
host_profile.projection: explicit/provisional storage and date/category fields are typed projections of the source view preservation and converter reset
host_profile.outside: outer Axes/Figure clear, generic converter callbacks and secondary lifecycle have separate references
